descriptions.preferred: This cultivar is one of the excellent dwarf shrubs with dense foliage. The five lobes radiate out and are separated to about halfway to the truncate leaf base. The lobes do not radiate in a star-shaped manner as strongly as do those of some other similar dwarf cultivars, such as which holds well during the entire season and does not seem too prone to sunburn. Fall colors range through the yellow tones. 'Shishi yatsubusa' is a strong but stubby-growing shrub which develops an angular limb structure with age. It is reported to be popular with bonsai hobbyists and is of fairly easy culture. However, propagating wood is always limited, which is understandable with the small annual growth produced. descriptions_zh.preferred: 该品种是叶幕浓密的优良矮生灌木之一。 5 枚裂片向外放射，分离至近截形叶基约一半处。 与某些其他相似矮生品种相比，其裂片放射状不那么强烈，不呈特别明显的星形展开。 叶色为良好的深绿色，整个生长季保持稳定，似乎也不太容易发生日灼。 秋色主要为黄色系。 ‘Shishi yatsubusa’ 生长强健但较短粗，随着树龄增长会形成棱角分明的枝干结构。 据称它很受盆景爱好者欢迎，且较易栽培。 不过，由于其年生长量有限，可供繁殖的枝条一直不多，这也在情理之中。 其名称意为“小狮子”或“幼狮”。 该品种还曾以 ‘Chishi yatsubusa’ 和 ‘Dwarf Shishi’ 的名称流传。
